title: Orbit Fare Machine
one_liner: Slide propellant cost, fuel share and payload to see the price per kilogram and your own ticket to orbit.
headline: Drag the sliders behind Peter Diamandis's Starship math and see your own orbit ticket price.

episode.title: Anthropic’s $1.4T IPO: The Biggest Wealth Event in Human History?

history.summary: A clean, self-contained build that faithfully reproduces the episode math. All podcast figures are sourced with timestamps, sliders are labelled as assumptions, and the risky payload-invention issue is avoided correctly. Verified calculations, presets and chart all work as specified.
